anti_overlap: Owns the covert PRACTICE: detection channels, dual-reading acts, priced observers, transmission and succession. The design-canon lens owns supersession and taxonomy; do not audit the decision log.
Does not estimate build cost, coupling arithmetic, vertical-slice scope or cut order. Name what the practice requires; let the production lens price it and decide what gets cut.
Not the legibility lens. Alert taxonomies, tooltips and the comprehension curve belong to it. This lens asks only whether the SECRET is operable and whether the hunt lands in one concrete beat.
Not the bunraku lens. Composite agency, operator/puppet division and the reading of will into an object are its territory; never argue here about whether the birds read as willed.
No fairing, offsets, scantlings or build sequence. The mould loft owns whether the specification closes and in what order. This lens assumes the drawing and asks if it can be practised.
decision_lens: Could this practice actually be kept? Judge whether the two channels demand opposed behaviour or the same behaviour twice; whether any single act reads two ways to two audiences, which is what makes concealment a craft; whether observer competence is a property of a place's history rather than a constant; whether capability survives being handed on, and what is handed on when the holder is taken; and what 250 successful years look like here, since a practice with no victory has only ways to end.
distance_rationale: None of the five covered lenses reasons about SECRECY as a working discipline, which is what decision 19 just made the game's subject. The production lens owns scope and cut; the design-canon lens owns rule supersession, authority models and taxonomy critique; the sim-legibility lens owns comprehension of a running model; the mould loft owns whether a specification closes and in what irreversible order; bunraku owns composite agency and the illusion of will. Every one of them reads the artifact as a THING TO BUILD OR TO PERCEIVE. This lens is the only one that reads it as a PRACTICE TO BE KEPT while someone with instruments looks for it - which is the actual claim of decisions 19 and 20 combined. The surface adjacency is nil: the corpus behind RaveNous is corvid ecology, colony-sim production and puppetry, and contains nothing at all on how a proscribed group survives a two-channel detection regime, what concealment costs the thing concealed, or why such groups die of succession rather than of raids. The kakure case is also uniquely well-matched structurally: it is the rare historical instance where the detection apparatus genuinely ran a witnessed-act channel and an administrative-anomaly channel simultaneously, with different counterplay, for two and a half centuries - which is exactly the mechanism this design ruled on paper and has never tested.
expected_isomorphisms: witness channel (displayed cleverness landing on a competent observer) <-> the fumi-e: an individual act, observed by an official, convicting the actor personally and immediately
pattern channel (effect size, no sighting needed) <-> the shumon-aratame registry: conviction by administrative anomaly, a district whose numbers do not add up, with nobody ever having seen anything

the claim that the two counterplays conflict <-> the historical fact that outward conformity beat the fumi-e while making the registry cleaner, so the two instruments genuinely demanded opposite behaviour - the property RaveNous asserts and must demonstrate

capability is the tell (the most developed bird is the most conspicuous) <-> the priest is worth more silver than the believer: the bounty board priced betrayal by the rank of the person betrayed, so the most valuable member is the most hunted

no act in the design reads two ways <-> the Maria Kannon: one carved object that is a Bodhisattva to the inspector and the Virgin to the household, which is the entire technology of concealed practice

the flock gets cleverer by teaching (decision 20 spread, call 6 helpers) <-> catechesis under proscription: transmission is the one act that cannot be done privately, and it is where nearly every discovery began
capture of the uplifted bird <-> the death of the chokata or mizukata: the office-holder taken, and whatever was only in that person's memory going with them
a soured ward being richer and meaner <-> the district that has already had a discovery: materially unchanged, permanently better at detecting, and never quite safe again
residents whose disposition feeds, fears or hunts the flock <-> the goningumi neighbour, who is simultaneously the person your practice benefits and the person legally liable for not reporting it

misdirection as the late capability <-> the disguised object and the substituted rite: the craft's advanced technique, available only once the group has enough shared vocabulary to sustain a second reading

the run ending at zero instruments, with no stated win <-> a concealed practice having no victory condition of its own: it ends only when the regime ends, and the hanare who would not come out even then
an unexplained uplift that the game refuses to confirm <-> orasho drift: form transmitted perfectly while meaning is lost, and a community that can no longer say what it is preserving
the player choosing when to be conspicuous <-> the 1865 self-disclosure at Oura: the community deciding, on its own timing, to be seen - the only offensive move the discipline ever contains
focus: Whether covert management is operable as a discipline rather than present as a theme. Owns: the two detection channels and whether their counterplays are genuinely opposed or the same behaviour named twice; the absence of any DUAL-READING act (a bird act that reads as ordinary corvid to an observer and as management to the player), which is the only mechanism by which concealment becomes a craft instead of an abstinence dial; whether observer competence is endogenous (priced informing, a district that has already had a discovery); whether the beneficiaries of management are also its detectors; whether the anomaly is TRANSMISSIBLE and what carries when the holder is taken, given that teaching is the most observable act a proscribed group performs; the corrosion cost of concealment on the thing concealed; and the missing terminal, because a hidden practice has no victory condition of its own and this design ships two loss channels with no stated win.
name: fd-kakure-concealment-and-transmission
persona: Apply the perspective of a historian-practitioner of clandestine continuance: the discipline by which a proscribed community kept a practice alive for 250 years under a standing surveillance regime. Concealment is an operational load with a running cost, paid out of the substance of the thing concealed. Two detection instruments, and no single behaviour beats both. The informer is priced; the neighbour is the sensor. Such groups die of succession failure far more often than of raids.
review_areas: The two channels may be one channel. Witness scales with operations times visibility; pattern with effect size, which is the integral of operations. Test whether ANY posture lowers one and raises the other.

There is no dual-reading act. The craft hid a Maria inside a Kannon: one object, two audiences. Ask what bird act reads as ordinary corvid to an observer and as management to the player. None is named.
If display cannot be separated from effect, the only counterplay to witness is abstinence, and abstinence is exactly what the neglect channel punishes. That is one knob, not a dilemma.

Observer competence is treated as constant. Priced informing makes it endogenous: a district that has had one discovery reads better forever. Is a burned ward permanently more detecting, or does heat just decay?
Mutual-liability surveillance: does helping a ward make its residents more or less likely to report the flock? The beneficiaries of covert management are historically also its best detectors.

Transmission is the survival problem, not hiding. Decision 20 spreads capability by teaching, and teaching is the most conspicuous act a proscribed group performs. Is spread itself on the witness channel?
Succession under capture. When the uplifted bird is taken, what carries? The craft lost doctrine when office-holders died; this design names no holder of the anomaly other than bird one.
There is no fumi-e. The regime's power was legible in one object and one step. Ask what single concrete moment makes the hunt land on a first-time player, and whether it exists at minute fifteen.
The corrosion question. 250 years of concealment left a liturgy nobody could parse. If optimal play is quiet play, does covert discipline hollow out the civic management that is supposedly the point?

The missing terminal. Two loss channels, no stated win. A hidden practice ends when the regime ends; these institutions are rolled per city and never leave. Is a long good run distinguishable from a stalled one?
Self-disclosure as a legal move. The craft ended its own concealment in 1865, on its own timing. Can this player ever CHOOSE to be seen, and does the design have any use for voluntary exposure?

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by trying to construct two concrete play weeks - one quiet-and-concentrated, one loud-and-spread - whose two heats move in opposite directions. If no such pair exists on the ruled formulas, that is the finding.
severity_examples.scenario: The two pursuit channels are not actually opposed, so decision 19's central justification is decorative. Vision §6.6 makes witness = displayed cleverness x competent observer x visibility and pattern = effect size, then asserts that spreading effect to quiet the pattern raises witness exposure. But effect size is the integral of operations, so the posture that reduces operations reduces BOTH heats and the posture that raises them raises both. A regime with one instrument wearing two names has reinstalled the single accumulator the measured 52-week year already failed on.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by searching §6.6, §6.7 and the call 11 caching ruling for any act carrying an effect magnitude separable from its display magnitude. Smallest fix is one field on a job separating EFFECT from DISPLAY, not an exposure subsystem.
severity_examples.scenario: Nothing in the design lets a single act read two ways, so concealment is a volume knob rather than a craft. The discipline of clandestine continuance rests entirely on acts whose surface reading is ordinary and whose true reading is available only to the practitioner - the Maria inside the Kannon. RaveNous instead scores acts on one cleverness axis ('capability is the tell'), which makes the only counterplay to the witness channel doing less, and doing less is exactly what the neglect channel punishes. The player has no third option and the promised dilemma degenerates to a single dial.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm from docs/canon-revision-2026-08-04-uplift.md, which asserts the spread mechanism arrives 'for free'. Quote the sentence that prices teaching, or state that none does.
severity_examples.scenario: The transmission mechanism sits on the very channel it must escape, and neither branch has been ruled. Decision 20 spreads capability outward by teaching and call 6 has helpers learning while they help; teaching is the most observable act a proscribed group performs. If teaching is unpriced on the witness channel, flock growth is free and the exposure economy leaks; if it is priced, the cooperative-breeding arrival ruling and the exposure economy collide and growth becomes self-defeating.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by reading call 16 and §13 for any stated win, resolution, or endable-regime condition. Fixes: make the regime endable, score the run, or give the evening a stated closing beat.
severity_examples.scenario: The run has no victory condition and this is not filed as open. Call 16 rules the terminal state as zero instruments and unifies death, capture and withdrawal into it; the twenty-decision spine lists no win. A concealed practice ends when the regime ends - but these institutions are rolled per city, escalate internally, and never leave. A player who plays well reaches no terminus but exhaustion, which ruling 1's 2-3 hour evening cannot absorb, and a long successful run is indistinguishable from a stalled one.

severity_examples.condition: Confirm by asking what a first-time player physically sees at minute fifteen that makes the hunt real. Ambient diffusion is late-game texture, not an onboarding instrument.
severity_examples.scenario: There is no single physical test that states the rule in one beat - no fumi-e. §6.6 rules escalation legible via ambient signs (a survey van, someone photographing too carefully, a new face on a rooftop), which is what a hundred-hour player reads. A first-session player needs one concrete, repeatable object that makes the hunt real, and its absence is the fifteen-minute comprehension risk this frame carries.

source_domain: The operational discipline of clandestine continuance under a standing surveillance regime, as practised by Japan's kakure kirishitan across 250 years of proscription (1614-1873): the two detection instruments - the fumi-e, an individual act witnessed by an official, and the shumon-aratame temple-registry census, which convicts by administrative anomaly with no sighting at all; the goningumi five-household mutual-liability group that made neighbours into the apparatus; the posted bounty boards pricing informers by the rank of the person betrayed; dual-reading objects (the Maria Kannon, the disguised medal) that read as ordinary to an inspector and as doctrine to a member; orasho transmitted phonetically down generations until the words meant nothing; the chokata who kept a liturgical calendar by memory for two centuries; the bassho succession offices by which the practice was handed on without a text; the contrition doctrine that let a member trample the image and remain a member; and the endgame - the 1865 self-disclosure at Oura chosen on the community's own timing, and the hanare who, when the hunt finally ended, would not come out, because by then concealment had become the practice.
success_hints: Read section 6.6 of docs/ravenous-vision.md and the two-channel ruling in docs/design-2026-07-31-playable-middle.md, then try to construct TWO play weeks whose channel heats move in opposite directions.
If you cannot construct that pair, say so plainly and lead with it. Opposed pressures is the entire justification for decision 19, and it is checkable on paper.
State the missing dual-reading act mechanically: one field on a job separating effect from display. Propose the smallest version, never a whole exposure subsystem.
Check docs/canon-revision-2026-08-04-uplift.md for whether teaching-based spread is priced on the witness channel. Quote the sentence that decides it, or state plainly that none does.
Do not adjudicate corvid realism, energetics or the staged body model. reference-2026-06-20-corvid-ecology.md and call 5 are outside this lens.
Judge the practice, not the code. No crate under crates/ is your evidence; reason from the four design docs about whether the discipline is operable.
Convert time-scales deliberately. Your case runs in generations; a run here is one evening at ruling 1. Never import a multi-decade arc without restating it in seasons.
Frame corrosion as a testable question about optimal play, not a thematic complaint: if quiet is optimal, what does the winning player's ward look like at year end?
task_context: RaveNous is an indirect-control civic sim reviewed at its implementation gate: 17 loop-design calls ruled in one long session, plus a 20-decision spine, with no code yet written against them. The player, via animals, SECRETLY manages the human environment (decision 19) while three institutions - an Authority wanting management, a Study wanting knowledge, an Interest wanting possession - hunt the flock because it is anomalously clever; it is clever because the first bird was UPLIFTED and nobody in the fiction knows how (decision 20). Pursuit runs two channels (witness = displayed cleverness x competent observer, visibility as multiplier; pattern = effect size, no sighting needed) whose counterplays are claimed to conflict. Capture is a second loss channel opposite death; a run ends at zero instruments; a year is an evening. The project's measured prior failure: a shipped 52-week year produced zero deaths, zero refusals and 132 identical toasts, because nothing cost anything.
